candidate_ideas.statement: The kernel of W_{26}H^{25}(M_{6,5};H)↠W_{26}H^{25}(M_{6,5};R^1 p_* Q) is pure Tate of type Q(-13), so purity of W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6}) reduces to purity of W_{26}H^{25}(M_{6,5};H).
For a free tetragonal pencil D one has W_5≅ω_C^{⊗2}(-D), hence W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}≅ω_C(-D), and Riemann–Roch gives h^0(C,ω_C(-D))=3 so the relative linear system is a P^2.
The evaluation-failure locus Z⊂M_{6,6} is a relative linear system of dimension 2 over the genus-6 balanced tetragonal Hurwitz space of dimension 15, giving dim Z=17 and codimension 4 in M_{6,6}.
The genus-6 balanced tetragonal Hurwitz space is rational/Tate, so the lowest-weight cohomology of Z is pure Tate.
A finite étale S_6-cover of the reduced-support relative linear system contributes only Tate local systems because S_6 has only rational irreducible representations.
On the complementary open U=M_{6,6}\Z where H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0, the CE resolution forces the lowest-weight cohomology of U to be pure Tate.

Via the Gysin sequence H^{18}(Z;Q)(-4)→H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)→H^{26}(U;Q), pure-Tate lowest weight of Z and U forces W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) to be pure Tate of type Q(-13), hence W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)≅⊕Q(8) after the Poincaré twist (21).

established_facts.statement: For d=3g-3+n, the open input W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}) is identified by Poincaré duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d).
For the RED residual list over Q, the ordinary degree 2d-16 equals vcd for (g,n) including (6,6) and never exceeds vcd, so vanishing-above-vcd alone does not resolve those cases.
For the forgetful map p:M_{6,6}→M_{6,5}, H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q)=0 because 26 exceeds vcd(M_{6,5})=25; fibre cohomology is only in q=0,1, so no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.
